effects.target: Summons one Fine insect scout per 4 caster levels to investigate one visible location or building for 1d6 hours unattended, then return from up to 1 mile per caster level. Each has 1 hp, AC 20, speed 5 ft., climb 5 ft., fly 20 ft. (perfect), your saving throws, Perception +5 + 1/2 your caster level, Stealth +18 + 1/2 your caster level even without cover, and cannot attack. effects.target: Summons up to one Fine black beetle spy per 4 caster levels. effects.target: Wraps you in a suit of opaque force armour that replaces any worn garments or armour and suppresses all benefit from what it replaces. It behaves as armour of its type in every way (armour bonus, max Dex, arcane spell failure) and, being force, incorporeal creatures cannot bypass it. Caster level sets the type: chainmail at 5th or lower, banded mail at 6th-8th, half-plate at 9th-11th, full plate at 12th or higher. Creating lesser armour than you could grants +1 enhancement per step passed over (so a 12th-level caster can make +1 half-plate, +2 banded mail or +3 chainmail); the bonus cannot be traded for special properties.

effects.target: Creates a perfect-looking illusory duplicate of the touched object (up to 1 pound per caster level). Held as a charge, it can be delivered as you steal the real item with Sleight of Hand or a steal manoeuvre, so the fake phases in exactly as the genuine article leaves, with no change in appearance or weight. Actively examining it with Appraise or Perception earns a Will save; on a failure the examiner concludes it is genuine. The fake is not a functional item and carries none of the original's magic: false thieves' tools pick no lock, a false warhammer harms nobody, unreal chainmail protects nothing, an illusory potion heals nothing.

effects.target: The touched creature or object (up to 100 pounds per level) becomes invisible, along with any gear a creature carries. Items put down become visible; items picked up and stowed vanish. Light itself never becomes invisible, though a light source can, giving a light with no visible source. Any carried item extending more than 10 feet from the subject is visible. The subject is not silenced, and things like swimming or stepping in a puddle can still betray it. The spell ends the moment the subject attacks a creature, which includes any spell targeting a foe or whose area includes one; actions against unattended objects and indirect harm are not attacks, so the subject may open doors, talk, summon monsters and set them attacking, cut a bridge's ropes or trigger a trap and stay hidden. Ally-only spells such as bless are not attacks even when foes stand in the area. On an object it can be made permanent with permanency.

effects.target: A 10-minute ritual that undoes Pharasma's judgment, returning a willing petitioner to mortal life.
